the 1H and 2H modes of pulsation are nearly indistinguishable in the SMC.

the P-L relations of the first and second-overtone Cepheid modes are indistinguishable within photometric accuracy, which is consistent with the findings of Alves (1998, AJ, in press).
the P-L relations for 1H and 2H Cephieds are indistinguishable.
the MACHO SMC sample of Cepheids is dominated by 1H pulsation, with a 2H mode that is not easily distinguished from 1H pulsations.
